seo.title: Dream Fitness | Personalized Workout & Nutrition App
seo.description: Achieve your fitness goals with Dream Fitness, your personal trainer and nutritionist in your pocket.
seo.keywords: fitness app, muscle building, weight loss, healthy meals, workout plans

project.title: Dream Fitness
project.shortDesc: Your daily companion for a healthier, stronger life.

overview.about: Dream Fitness is a mobile-first wellness ecosystem that bridges the gap between expert coaching and daily life. It provides users with mathematically calculated meal plans based on their biological data and progressive workout routines that adapt as they grow stronger.
overview.goal: To democratize high-level fitness coaching by providing an affordable, scientific, and accessible tool for everyone.
overview.audience: Fitness enthusiasts, individuals looking to lose weight, and anyone seeking a healthier lifestyle.

challenge.description: The main challenge was creating a nutrition algorithm that could handle thousands of meal combinations while keeping the UI simple and encouraging. We also needed a seamless way to track progressive overload in workouts.
points: High-engagement UI/UX for daily habit building

solution.description: We built a custom algorithm for nutrition and a comprehensive video library for exercises. The app features a 'Strength Curve' tracker and a 'Meal Swap' system to prevent dietary boredom.
solution.approach: Gamified health tracking combined with scientifically backed coaching methods.

features.title: Custom Workouts
features.desc: Adaptive training plans that evolve with your performance levels.

features.title: Smart Nutrition
features.desc: Meal plans generated based on your exact calorie and macro requirements.

features.title: Progress Tracker
features.desc: Visual analytics for body measurements, weight, and strength gains.

features.title: Video Coaching
features.desc: High-definition exercise demonstrations to ensure perfect form.

design.philosophy: Energizing and Focused. Using high-contrast vibrant colors to evoke motivation and clarity.

results.impact: Helped users lose a combined total of 50,000kg and achieved a 4.9/5 rating on both app stores.

pain_points.title: Wellness Gaps.
pain_points.quote: Success is the sum of small efforts, repeated day in and day out.
defaults: Generic meal plans that ignore individual metabolic rates.
Static workout routines that lead to plateaus.
Overwhelming nutritional data without clear action steps.
Lack of real-time wearable integration for accurate burn.

strategy.title: The Growth Roadmap
strategy.desc: Converting complex biological data into simple daily actions.

phases.title: Bio-Mapping
phases.desc: Analyzing user metabolic profiles and goal parameters.

phases.title: Adaptive Engine
phases.desc: Building progressive overload algorithms for workouts.

phases.title: Nutrition Hub
phases.desc: Implementing the dynamic meal-swap and calorie engine.

phases.title: Wearable Sync
phases.desc: Connecting with Google Fit and Apple HealthKit.

compatibility.label: Omni-Store Integrity
compatibility.title: Native-Grade Performance
compatibility.desc: The app delivers a consistent experience across both premium iPhone and mid-range Android devices, ensuring the UI stays fluid and responsive on any health journey.
